mapper.select: SELECT s.stu_id, s.user_id, s.major, s.grade, s.class_name, s.rank_level, s.rank_score, s.total_questions, s.correct_questions, s.study_hours, u.real_name, u.avatar FROM my_student s, my_sys_user u WHERE s.user_id = u.user_id AND s.stu_id = #{stuId}

SELECT sc.sc_id, sc.stu_id, sc.c_id, sc.progress, sc.status AS course_status, sc.score, c.c_name, c.type AS course_type, c.tag AS course_tag, c.difficulty FROM my_student_course sc, my_course c WHERE sc.c_id = c.c_id AND sc.stu_id = #{stuId} ORDER BY sc.create_time DESC
SELECT re_id, c_id, resource_type, title AS resource_title, content, file_url, video_url FROM my_course_resource WHERE c_id = #{cId} ORDER BY sort_order

SELECT sr.sr_id, sr.stu_id, sr.c_id, sr.study_type, sr.study_duration, sr.study_date, c.c_name, c.type AS course_type, c.tag AS course_tag FROM my_study_record sr, my_course c WHERE sr.c_id = c.c_id AND sr.stu_id = #{stuId} AND sr.study_type = 3 ORDER BY sr.study_date DESC

SELECT sh.submit_time, sh.score AS student_score, sh.teacher_comment, sh.correct_time, hw.hw_id, hw.title, hw.content, hw.total_score, hw.deadline, c.c_name, c.type AS course_type, c.tag AS course_tag, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM my_question q WHERE q.hw_id = hw.hw_id) AS question_count FROM my_student_homework sh, my_homework hw, my_course c WHERE sh.hw_id = hw.hw_id AND hw.c_id = c.c_id AND sh.stu_id = #{stuId} AND sh.status = 2 ORDER BY sh.submit_time DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT sh.submit_time, sh.score AS student_score, sh.teacher_comment, sh.correct_time, hw.hw_id, hw.title, hw.content, hw.total_score, hw.deadline, c.c_name, c.type AS course_type, c.tag AS course_tag, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM my_question q WHERE q.hw_id = hw.hw_id) AS question_count FROM my_student_homework sh, my_homework hw, my_course c WHERE sh.hw_id = hw.hw_id AND hw.c_id = c.c_id AND sh.stu_id = #{stuId} AND sh.status = 2 ORDER BY sh.submit_time DESC

SELECT c.c_id, c.c_name, c.type AS course_type, COUNT(eb.eb_id) AS error_count, SUM(CASE WHEN eb.is_mastered = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mastered_count FROM my_error_book eb, my_course c WHERE eb.c_id = c.c_id AND eb.stu_id = #{stuId} GROUP BY c.c_id, c.c_name, c.type ORDER BY error_count DESC

SELECT sc.c_id, c.c_name, c.type AS course_type, c.tag AS course_tag, sc.progress, sc.status, sc.score, sc.remark, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM my_course_resource cr WHERE cr.c_id = c.c_id) AS resource_count FROM my_student_course sc, my_course c WHERE sc.c_id = c.c_id AND sc.stu_id = #{stuId} ORDER BY sc.update_time DESC

SELECT report_id, report_type, report_date, study_duration, completed_courses, completed_homework, correct_rate, rank_score_change, weak_points, strengths, suggestions FROM my_study_report WHERE stu_id = #{stuId} ORDER BY report_date DESC, report_type ASC LIMIT 20
SELECT rank_id, rank_name, min_score, max_score, color, description FROM my_rank_config ORDER BY sort_order

SELECT report_id, report_type, report_date, study_duration, completed_homework, correct_rate, rank_score_change, weak_points, strengths, suggestions FROM my_study_report WHERE stu_id = #{stuId} ORDER BY report_date DESC, report_type DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT tr_id, task_type, task_title, task_content, remind_time, repeat_type, is_read, related_id FROM my_task_reminder WHERE stu_id = #{stuId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY remind_time ASC LIMIT 20

SELECT sh.sh_id, sh.hw_id, hw.title, hw.content, hw.deadline, hw.total_score, c.c_name, sh.status, sh.submit_time FROM my_student_homework sh, my_homework hw, my_course c WHERE sh.hw_id = hw.hw_id AND hw.c_id = c.c_id AND sh.stu_id = #{stuId} AND sh.status IN (0, 1) ORDER BY hw.deadline ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM my_student_homework WHERE stu_id = #{stuId} AND status = 2

SELECT ROUND(AVG(sh.score * 100.0 / hw.total_score)) FROM my_student_homework sh, my_homework hw WHERE sh.hw_id = hw.hw_id AND sh.stu_id = #{stuId} AND sh.status = 2 AND hw.total_score > 0 AND sh.score IS NOT NULL

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(sh.correct_time, sh.submit_time), '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM my_student_homework sh WHERE sh.stu_id = #{stuId} AND sh.status = 2 AND COALESCE(sh.correct_time, sh.submit_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(sh.correct_time, sh.submit_time), '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY day ASC

SELECT c.type AS course_type, ROUND(AVG(sh.score * 100.0 / hw.total_score)) AS avg_rate FROM my_student_homework sh, my_homework hw, my_course c WHERE sh.hw_id = hw.hw_id AND hw.c_id = c.c_id AND sh.stu_id = #{stuId} AND sh.status = 2 AND hw.total_score > 0 AND sh.score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.type
